name: Never Saddle on Quality

angles.text: Amberstill Ranch breeds rams to reinforce Alliance forces in Alterac's freezing heights.
Dun Morogh's hardy mountain rams are iconic dwarven mounts. Their breeders at Amberstill Ranch refuse to equip them with substandard gear.
Skilled trackers and hunters are needed to seek out Dun Morogh's fiercest mountain leopards and secure pristine pelts.

aliases: what is never saddle on quality
faq.answer: At Amberstill Ranch in Dun Morogh, a breeder needs high-quality leopard pelts for warm, sturdy saddles. The saddles are for a team of rams being readied as reinforcements for the Alterac expedition.
faq.q: What is Never Saddle on Quality?

faq.answer: Leopard pelts provide the thick fur needed to make durable, warm saddles for the expedition's mounts. The insulation protects riders and beasts from Alterac's biting mountain chill.
The mounts are bound for Alliance forces in the Alterac expedition. Well-equipped riding rams are vital support in the harsh weather and ongoing operations in the high passes.
faq.q: Where are the rams being sent?

faq.answer: Amberstill Ranch lies in Dun Morogh, east of Kharanos. It is the main breeding and training ground for dwarven mountain rams.
faq.q: What is Amberstill Ranch's role here?

faq.answer: The leopards roam the snowy ridges and eastern crags of Dun Morogh, east of Amberstill Ranch. Hunters seek the largest beasts there for their pristine hides.
Alterac's kingdom and peaks are freezing and windswept. Without thick, high-quality saddle material, mounts and riders risk frostbite and exhaustion in the mountains.
faq.q: Why is cold weather protection so important for the expedition?

sections.body: At Amberstill Ranch in Dun Morogh, handlers are preparing sturdy mountain rams to reinforce the Alliance expedition in Alterac. But the work has stalled: they lack the material needed to make durable, cold-weather saddles for the rams.
sections.title: Mounting the Expedition

sections.body: The expedition's mounts need thick insulation to endure the freeze of the Alterac mountains. Hunters are sent to the eastern crags to track the largest, fiercest mountain leopards in Dun Morogh and bring back pristine pelts. The Alliance forces need gear that can withstand the high passes.
sections.title: Warmth for the High Passes

summary: At Amberstill Ranch, handlers prepare rams for the Alliance expedition in Alterac. They need pristine mountain leopard pelts to make warm saddles for the beasts, so mounts and riders can face the northern mountains' biting frost.
attribution: In-game quest text: Never Saddle on Quality
